# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The latest version on the default branch is supported for security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open a public issue.

Instead, report it privately by contacting the maintainers through one of the
support channels listed in `SUPPORT.md`, and include:

- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce, if available
- Potential impact
- Suggested mitigation (optional)

We will acknowledge receipt as soon as possible and investigate promptly.

## Disclosure Process

- We will confirm whether the report is valid
- We will work on a fix and coordinate release timing
- We may ask for additional details during triage
- We will credit responsible disclosure where appropriate
